svg.title: Two of the ten OWASP ASI 2026 categories are content-adjacent; the other eight require system controls outside the model call.
svg.desc: Agent Goal Hijack and Memory Poisoning are the two OWASP Agentic Security Initiative Top 10 categories where a content filter can contribute. The remaining eight — tool misuse, identity abuse, supply chain, cascading agent failures, insecure agent-to-agent communication, and rogue agents or goal drift — require controls in identity, tool policy, sandboxing, and supply-chain management, not text filtering.

svg.text: The other eight need identity, tool, sandbox, and supply-chain controls.
